_comment: LandfallElementals sweep s61002 (2026-10-19): a land-search crack SHUFFLES, so it must be orderable BEFORE a library-top reader in one plan (Plan::land_search_act_slot reader twins + the pre-cast subset). Board: Aether Vial on 3, Fiery Islet, Secluded Courtyard, Myriad Landscape, Flamekin Harbinger, 2x Akoum Hellhound (+2/+2 per landfall). Hand: Risen Reef, Terramorphic Expanse. Library top: Swords to Plowshares over Forest filler. Opponent at 20. With every crack in the trailing pass (the only order before the fix) the Vial-put Reef looks at the Swords: 4 landfalls (Expanse drop, Myriad x2, Expanse crack) = 2 x 8 + Harbinger 1 = 17, no kill this turn (T5). Cracking Myriad (or both) BEFORE the Reef lets its look take a Forest off the reshuffled top: a 5th landfall, 2 x 10 + 1 = 21 -> the T4 kill. Discriminates on every seed tried (61002, 1-5): base T5, fixed T4.
